info.title: Ankra API
info.description:
Read and write an Ankra workspace from your games and scripts. Generate a key in Ankra's Settings › Developer.

Every request sends the key as `Authorization: Bearer ws_…` and the workspace as `?workspace_id=`: the ID in the
workspace's Ankra address, or its UUID. Each key works for its own workspace only.

People are named by `roblox_user_id`. Parameters go in the query string for GET and DELETE, and in a JSON body
otherwise. An action belonging to a module answers 403 while that module is turned off. Errors come back as
`{ "error": "…" }`.
